name: Atlassian
summary: Jira and Confluence maker; this profile links source-backed MLE/MLSE coding and ML system design practice.

interview_process.evidence_tier: Official general engineering format plus role-specific candidate reports
interview_process.summary: The official general engineering handbook distinguishes data structures, code design and systems design. MLE/MLSE reports add ML design and project-depth discussions; a fixed loop is not established for every team.

stages.name: Coding and design
stages.signal: Practice follows the reported task and progressive follow-ups; a round labeled ML coding may still ask a generic data-structure task.
stages.evidence_tier: Original MLE/MLSE reports; not a universal team-specific process
